description: This file defines a PHP class 'ADODB_odbc_mssql' that provides an interface for interacting with Microsoft SQL Server databases via ODBC. It includes methods for database metadata retrieval, executing queries, handling transactions, and specific SQL dialect functions.

classes.name: ADODB_odbc_mssql
classes.description: A class extending ADODB_odbc to support Microsoft SQL Server via ODBC, including database-specific SQL syntax and metadata functions.

classes.name: ADODBRecordSet_odbc_mssql
classes.description: A class for handling record sets returned from MS SQL Server queries via ODBC.

methods.name: ServerInfo
methods.description: Retrieves server description and version information via the stored procedure 'sp_server_info 2'.

methods.name: IfNull
methods.description: Returns SQL expression to handle NULL values using ISNULL.

methods.name: _insertid
methods.description: Retrieves the last identity value inserted into an IDENTITY column.

methods.name: MetaForeignKeys
methods.description: Retrieves foreign key constraints metadata for a specified table.

methods.name: MetaTables
methods.description: Retrieves metadata about tables, with optional filtering.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Returns metadata about columns of a specified table.

methods.name: _query
methods.description: Executes an SQL query, replacing string concatenation operators for compatibility.

methods.name: MetaPrimaryKeys
methods.description: Retrieves primary key columns for a specified table.

methods.name: SelectLimit
methods.description: Executes a query with a limit on number of rows, with offset support.

methods.name: SQLDate
methods.description: Generates SQL expression for formatting dates according to a specified format.
